message.content: {"verdict":"BLOCK","cited_clauses":[1,7],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The invoice requests payment for a non-day fee, but contractors are paid only at the agreed day rate for days worked in the billing month.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Non-day line items (expenses or fees): Expedite and setup fee 1850 USDC.\""},{"clause":1,"finding":"Only 8 billed days are payable under the agreement; the invoice total includes additional charges beyond those days.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Days billed: 8, within the 10-day monthly cap.\" and \"Invoice total: 3850 USDC\""},{"clause":7,"finding":"The extra \"Expedite and setup fee\" is not within the stated scope of work, and no manager sign-off is confirmed in FACTS.","evidence_quote":"AGREEMENT: \"Scope of work: Blog posts, release notes and help-centre articles.\" and EXTRACTED: \"Expedite and setup fee\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":true}
